0022600119.text: The Washington Wizards (2-1, 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East, on a one-game win streak) make the trip to the Charlotte Hornets (2-1, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) for their fourth game of the season. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel (both hamstring), Kylan Boswell (knee surgery) and Naz Reid, who is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Wizards lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026.
